findings.claim: The new location filter does not drop metadata-symbol diagnostics that have been converted to Location.None. For a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly with a public member lacking [Key], the null-safe MemberNeedsKey path creates MsgPack004 with a null location; !diagnostic.Location.IsInSource is then true, so the consumer compilation receives a locationless MsgPack004 error. This both contradicts the helper's stated behavior and analyses metadata types that the defining assembly owns.

receipt_plan.detail: Compile a Lib metadata reference containing [MessagePackObject] public partial struct Item<T> { public int Value { get; set; } } without running analyzers on Lib. Analyze an App compilation referencing Lib and containing [MessagePackObject] public class Cmd { [Key(0)] public Item<int> Member { get; set; } }. Assert that App has no MsgPack004, AD0001, or CS8785. On head, MsgPack004 is reported with Location.None instead of being dropped.
